slides.headline: Miccosukee Indigenous Film Festival, Oct. 9-12
slides.body: The first-ever festival screens 22 Indigenous-made films at Bill Cosford Cinema in Coral Gables. All-access tickets cost $85.

slides.headline: The Science Behind Pixar opens Oct. 10
slides.body: Frost Science opens the exhibit on Saturday at Philip and Patricia Frost Museum of Science in Miami. Adult tickets start at $29.95, and youth tickets ages 4 to 11 start at $24.95.

slides.headline: Coastal Corgi Classic at Gulfstream Park, Oct. 10
slides.body: The corgi race takes over the Gulfstream Park track in Hallandale Beach. Check-in starts at 11 a.m., the costume contest is at 12 p.m., and the first corgi race starts at 1 p.m.

slides.headline: In a Landscape opens Oct. 8
slides.body: Opa Projects opens the show in Miami on Thursday. The exhibit features work by Stephen Thorpe, Annie Lapin, Jonathan Ryan, Christiane Pooley and Mattia Sinigaglia.
